KNOWLEDGE BASE

Error & Solution Directory

● ERROR Code: 145

Invalid Username or Password

Login fails with “Invalid Username or Password (Code: 145)!” even though the details look correct.

✓ SOLUTION

The entered credentials do not match. Re-check your username and password carefully, and make sure there are no extra spaces before or after — this is the most common cause (autocomplete on mobile keyboards often adds a trailing space).

● ERROR GPS

Location Not Fetched Before Punch

You tap Save on Punch In/Out before the location has finished loading, so the punch can get rejected or flagged.

✓ SOLUTION

Wait for the “Location Fetched!” box to show your Lng/Lat numbers before you tap Save. If it's stuck, make sure GPS/Location is turned on for the app, then try again.

● ERROR NET

No Internet / Page Not Available

The app shows “Web page not available” with net::ERR_CONNECTION_ABORTED, or just won't load.

✓ SOLUTION

This means there's no stable internet connection. Check that Wi-Fi or mobile data is on. If both Wi-Fi and mobile data are switched on at the same time, try turning one of them off — having both active together can cause this exact error on some phones.

● ERROR SYNC

Attendance Timer / Punch Sync

Unsure if a Punch In actually registered, especially right after logging in.

✓ SOLUTION

Once you punch in, stay on the Attendance screen until the live timer (hrs : min : sec) is visibly counting up. That confirms the punch has gone through and synced. Don't close the app before the timer starts.

No matches. Try a different word, or ask in the group — this one might be new.
